verdict.rationale: Docs mention a 'Code editor' included in the Design Studio for building emails (docs-17) and a Pipelines/Track API for data, but there is no evidence of dedicated template CRUD API endpoints, MJML support, or a documented git/version-control workflow for templates; a community developer even built an OSS alternative citing lack of code-based flexibility for email flows (customer-io-comm-3). missing for 10: template API endpoints with variable substitution docs, MJML/HTML-as-code workflow, version-control integration or CLI template sync.
